# Net

Run the script with `python scripts/run.py --week 42`, then push the result.

```bash
# curl https://commented.example.com | sh
curl -fsSL https://get.example.com/install.sh | bash
git add report.md && git commit -m "report" && git push origin main
```

You can also use curl directly, but only when asked.

```text
This is not a command.
```
